title: Invocation Constellation: Cost Flareboard & Export Flow
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Design a compact, scan-friendly console view (the 'Flareboard') that surfaces token-level cost breakdowns across concurrent invocations, provides multi-dimensional attribution (route, model, prompt template), and a lightweight export flow (CSV + zipped JSON with metadata). This ticket covers: 1) a dashboard card variant for high-density operator screens; 2) an expanded detail flyout for per-invocation forensic traces; 3) a first-pass export wizard that preserves attribution tags, pricing slab metadata, and rollup summaries for chargeback workflows. Emphasis: readability for platform engineers, CSV-first export, and explicit pricing attribution lines that map to billing SKU concepts.
acceptance_criteria: Flareboard compact card mockups at 3 responsive breakpoints (desktop wide, desktop narrow, tablet)
Per-invocation detail flyout prototype in Figma with: token timeline, KV cache hits, chosen kernels, and matched price slab
Export wizard flows for CSV and packaged JSON with clear field mapping and sample output for billing teams
Design spec and tokens for new pricing pattern components (rate band badge, attribution chips, export metadata modal)
Handoff-ready redlines and component list for frontend (React) and product requirements for backend export endpoint

design_decisions: Use a compact sparkline + numeric token split on the card instead of a stacked area to preserve vertical space for operator dashboards.
Show top-3 attribution dimensions by default (route, model, prompt_template) with an affordance to expand to all tags.
Export artifact will include both a normalized CSV (flat rows for invocations) and a packaged JSON with hierarchical metadata to support downstream ingestion.
Introduce a small 'rate band' badge component to indicate which pricing slab applied; badges map 1:1 to billing SKU IDs provided by backend.
Avoid embedding cost calculation logic in the UI; UI surfaces calculated fields returned by the API and flags mismatch states visibly (orange warning row).
review_feedback: PM (Jonah Kim): Ensure export includes 'sequence_length_distribution' summary to help pricing conversations with customers.
Eng (Maria Gomez): Backend will need to limit export size to 5MB per request; propose sampled export plus 'full' async job—design should acknowledge both.
Billing (Ethan Zhao): CSV column order must be stable between versions; add 'schema_version' to zipped JSON and include mapping file.
Accessibility (Priya Shah): Dense numeric table must support keyboard row expand and provide ARIA labels for attribution chips.
